title: Conveyor Operators and Tenders
description: Control or tend conveyors or conveyor systems that move materials or products to and from stockpiles, processing stations, departments, or vehicles. May control speed and routing of materials or products.
tasks: Inform supervisors of equipment malfunctions that need to be addressed.
Observe conveyor operations and monitor lights, dials, and gauges to maintain specified operating levels and to detect equipment malfunctions.
Record production data such as weights, types, quantities, and storage locations of materials, as well as equipment performance problems and downtime.
Load, unload, or adjust materials or products on conveyors by hand, by using lifts, hoists, and scoops, or by opening gates, chutes, or hoppers.
Stop equipment or machinery and clear jams, using poles, bars, and hand tools, or remove damaged materials from conveyors.
Distribute materials, supplies, and equipment to work stations, using lifts and trucks.

work_contexts.Exposed to Sounds, Noise Levels that are: Once a week or more but not every day
work_contexts.Exposed to Contaminants: Once a week or more but not every day
work_contexts.Time Pressure: Once a week or more but not every day
